beforeImage.name: Phoenix Rail
beforeImage.description: Phoenix Rail is a short line freight rail platform formed to acquire and grow regional rail infrastructure in North America. The business serves industrial shippers, transload users, and logistics customers through an asset-heavy rail operating model tied to track, terminals, and rolling stock access. Ancala and Arkadia formed the platform in 2025 and announced the acquisition of Lehigh Valley Rail Management as the first transaction. Public materials for the initial asset describe a 61-mile railroad and terminal operation in Pennsylvania serving more than 100 customers. Reviewed public sources do not disclose the ownership percentages between Ancala and Arkadia.

afterImage.name: Phoenix Rail
afterImage.description: Phoenix Rail is a Denver-headquartered short-line freight rail and intermodal platform formed by Ancala Partners and Arkadia Rail Partners to acquire and grow regional rail infrastructure across the United States. The company owns and operates railroads and rail-related businesses serving more than 100 customers across consumer products, plastics, metals, agriculture, building products, food and chemicals. Its wholly owned subsidiary, Lehigh Valley Rail Management, operates a 61-mile freight rail network and intermodal terminal in Pennsylvania with access to Norfolk Southern, CSX and CPKC. Phoenix Rail completed the LVRM acquisition on January 28, 2025, and Ancala publicly describes its interest in the platform as a significant controlling stake; no exact percentage or fund vehicle is publicly disclosed.
